description: Reliability PR 5's seventh action set (docs/plans/reliability/5-english-baseline.md, v7): v5's calibration fixtures for work start and review fix verbatim (review r5), and 54 held-out fixtures for each written fresh (review r7), labels balanced (work start 18 per label, review fix 27 per label), to test the prompts changed on v5's results. Check choice has no v7 fixtures; v5's result stands. Labels mean what they mean in the first set.

r5.note: The fresh held-out half, the pages only it names and the fresh action fixtures, a model review at the repository owner's direction: two full-set rounds by gpt-6.1-sol before any v5 held-out run (round 1: work-start file locators that gave the label away, a status-code rule that contradicted the input-validation rule replaced, a meeting that contradicted the written stand-up decision, an ambiguous connection count, an unsupported first-step reference replaced, two bridge targets that shared words with their queries; the remaining work-start and review-fix surface cues broken with them; round 2: nothing found). Approved inputs: intents 45d2814a, actions f7db1f43.
